profile.headline: Android Developer I AI Engineer at Bond Dynamics
profile.summary:
Experienced Android Developer with a proven track record of delivering high-quality mobile
applications. Possessing a strong background in Kotlin and Java, I excel in developing intuitive user
interfaces and seamless navigation using Android Jetpack and MVVM architecture. Skilled in
integrating backend services and APIs, developing front-end and backend components for web pages,
and connecting all components of a company's IT infrastructure.

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Developed front-end solutions for Android in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose and XML
Leveraged and developed backend APIs in Java for transfer of inventory data to database
Incorporated SQL for integrating and manipulating tables
Developed web pages using Vue.js (JavaScript, HTML, and CSS) for front-end, and Python for backend
Supported on-site teams during critical moments, such as go-lives and system failures
Responded to hot messages in a timely manner with efficient solutions
Managed pipelines and site wide deployments
Debugged and fixed critical frontend and backend issues, such as crashes, incorrect data, and non-functional UI
Altered Kubernetes configs in YAML to keep site information up to date
Utilized Microsoft Copilot AI to improve workflow and optimize code for maximum computational efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Java · Web Development · REST APIs · WebSocket · Kotlin Coroutines · Vuetify · Android Jetpack

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Developed UI and UX screen components and navigation routes using Jetpack Compose
Implemented user authentication and other backend dependencies using Firebase libraries
Leveraged backend repositories and API calls
Consulted with key stakeholders to understand necessary requirements
Maintained legacy repository
Developed multi-platform components with Android Native, React Native, and Flutter
Worked with focus groups to create aesthetic and functional UI
Utilized generative AI for rapid Jetpack Compose prototyping and automated unit test generation

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.locationName: Sandy Springs, Georgia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Implemented and tested push notifications using NotificationCompat library according to UX and UI team specifications (builder, pass channel id to builder function, worked on special deals, json response from internal server api endpoint based on customer preferences from using the app)
Rest API calls using retrofit to update kotlin flows, using coroutines and MVVM to update composables asynchronously.
Collaborated with UI and UX teams to help create user friendly experience according to mockups from zeplin
Tested push notification changes that were implemented using junit4 and mockk
Updated legacy code from Java with rxJava to Kotlin with Kotlin coroutines
positions.insights: Skills: Android Framework · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Mobile Application Development · JUnit · Android Jetpack · Kotlin · Android Studio · RxJava

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Implemented Facebook SSO (Single Sign On) for the login fragment to help increase security and UX.
Documented the requirements. Analyzed and involved in coding and design
Services, Intents, Handles, Threads, Asynchronous tasks, Shared preferences, Broadcast receivers and third-party libraries such as Butter Knife, Dagger, Rx java, and Retrofit
Designed the UI using various custom views, dialog boxes, alert boxes, buttons, layouts, and other forms of widgets
Used Retrofit to get RESTful API json response into Moshi Gson object for use populating recyclerviews in the search fragment
Used Firebase Crashlytics and LeakCannary to identify critical issues affecting the app with crashes and memory leaks

positions.title: Jr. Android Developer
positions.description:
Tested UI using Mockito and increased viewmodel test coverage to 92% from 12% using Junit 4 Implemented navigation jetpack component to implement SOLID principles MVVM architecture 
Used Kotlin coroutines and Asynchronous tasks for operations in the background 
Updated app to better optimize for various orientations and resolutions using constraint layouts and recycler views 
Updated app architecture to adhere to SOLID principles using scope functions, and decoupling legacy code that handled business logic and navigation 
Worked with team to implement data collection on device coarse and fine location and used for analytics in the app Worked with team through all SDLC phases, from requirements gathering and design, through testing porting and supporting the app Used content providers to update the user's data, increasing UX per UX team specifications
